title: Fix griffe import break in tactus runtime dependency graph
description: Root cause: pydantic-ai import path expects python module 'griffe', but latest resolved griffe 2.x packaging in downstream installs does not provide importable module for current stack, causing runtime ModuleNotFoundError in Tactus and downstream Plexus tests. Implement upstream dependency fix in Tactus and validate by local install in Plexus.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Starting implementation. Plan: (1) constrain/update Tactus dependencies so pydantic-ai runtime can import griffe reliably, (2) regenerate lock and run focused Tactus validation, (3) install local Tactus into Plexus env and rerun failing TestRealTactusRuntime tests.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Observed that current Tactus repo already specifies pydantic-ai==1.46.0 and griffe<2 in pyproject. Next: validate downstream by locally installing ../Tactus into Plexus environment and rerunning failing TestRealTactusRuntime tests.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Validated downstream with local editable install of ../Tactus into Plexus py311 env; this replaced griffe 2.0.0 with griffe 1.15.0 and pydantic-ai 1.46.0. Re-ran Plexus tests: tests/scores/test_tactus_score.py::TestRealTactusRuntime => 6 passed. Confirms fix is in local Tactus source/dependency spec and issue is consumption of older published artifact/metadata.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Investigating semantic-release failure in GitHub run 23203224309. Initial signal from run annotations: 'Failed to push branch (main) to remote'. Reviewing release workflow auth/token config next.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Confirmed root cause from run 23203224309 logs via gh CLI: semantic-release failed on git push with GH013 repository rule violation for refs/heads/main. Ruleset main-branch-protection requires PR + 4 status checks and currently has bypass_actors=[]. Therefore any direct push from workflow token is blocked. anthusbot token alone will not help unless anthusbot (or GitHub Actions app) is added as ruleset bypass actor.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Implementing requested changes: update release.yml to use anthusbot token/identity and add declarative ruleset bypass for release automation in branch-protection IaC source (platform-ci), then sync generated Tactus ruleset JSON.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Implemented requested release/ruleset updates. Tactus release workflow now uses ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN for checkout, semantic-release GH_TOKEN, and release-asset upload token, and sets git identity to anthusbot. Added ruleset bypass actor for anthusbot (actor_id=266826422, actor_type=User, bypass_mode=always) in Tactus infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json. Also updated platform-ci infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json with same bypass so shared IaC baseline includes it. Validated YAML/JSON parse successfully.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Running local token diagnostics (no code changes): verify ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN identity and access against GitHub API.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Applying Virtuus-aligned release auth pattern to Tactus release workflow: checkout with persist-credentials=false, explicit git remote set-url with ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN, and provide both GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN to semantic-release.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Updated release.yml to match proven Virtuus auth pattern: checkout persist-credentials=false, explicit origin remote set-url with ANTHUSBOT_GH_TOKEN, validate token presence, and provide both GITHUB_TOKEN + GH_TOKEN to semantic-release. This removes ambiguity about which credential git push uses.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Extending scope: standardize semantic-release via shared platform-ci reusable workflow and migrate Tactus wrapper to consume it alongside Virtuus.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Implemented Tactus migration to shared reusable semantic-release workflow in platform-ci. release job now calls AnthusAI/platform-ci/.github/workflows/semantic-release-reusable.yml@main with anthusbot and pypi secrets; desktop build job continues to gate on needs.release.outputs and consume tag/version outputs. Validated workflow YAML parse.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
